title: GitHub - AML-memory/agent-memory-leaderboard
author: IreneAI
content:
Public Evaluation Code

This directory publishes the answer-generation and evaluation contracts used by the Agent Memory Leaderboard for its public datasets.

The scripts require Python 3.10 or newer and the dependency listed in requirements.txt. Service URLs, model names, and credentials must be supplied through CLI arguments or environment variables; no credential is bundled here.

Provenance and integrity

Internal shorthand labels are normalized to descriptive public names; answer construction and scoring behavior are unchanged.

The disclosed runtime behavior covers Add/Search/Answer concurrency, timeouts, retries, key rotation, checkpoints, and aggregation. Internal deployment code, service addresses, credentials, databases, datasets, and run artifacts are intentionally outside this public evaluation release.

Disclosed production parameters

  • Full task timeout: 72 hours; retrieval top_k: 100.
  • Add: 64 global workers by default, 48-record per-dataset hard cap, 20-message chunks, 1,200-second HTTP timeout, and global-largest-next-record-v1 scheduling using estimated chunk counts.
  • Search: 32 workers, 1,200-second HTTP timeout, six request attempts, up to three failed-record requeues, and adaptive concurrency reduction after five retryable 5xx responses.
  • Answer: 32 workers, gpt-4o-mini, temperature 0, 180-second HTTP timeout, and six attempts. The configured checkpoint value is 128 tokens, but the outbound provider request intentionally does not send max_tokens.
  • Judge: a configured evaluator, 360-second HTTP timeout, and a global cap of 15 requests. Worker phase limits are 8 for binary evaluation, 15 for rubric evaluation, and 16 for BEAM event alignment; the global cap means effective Judge request concurrency never exceeds 15.
  • Judge failures: HTTP 429, timeout, and transport failures rotate the key. Pool-wide 429 exhaustion uses a 30-second cooldown and at most three cooldown rounds. Qwen JSON requests set enable_thinking=false.
  • Scores are computed on [0, 1] internally and published on [0, 100].
aiSummary: 该 GitHub 仓库为 Agent Memory Leaderboard 提供评估契约与脚本，详细说明了基于 LLM 的智能体的生产参数、服务配置与评分机制。
oneSentenceSummary: 该 GitHub 仓库为 Agent Memory Leaderboard 提供评估契约与脚本，详细说明了基于 LLM 的智能体的生产参数、服务配置与评分机制。
summary: 本文记录了 Agent Memory Leaderboard 的公开评估框架，包括所需依赖（Python 3.10+）、服务配置参数（超时、并发、重试逻辑）以及评分方法。文中概述了 Add/Search/Answer/Judge 操作的整体架构，并提供了 worker 数量、令牌限制和错误处理等具体技术细节。虽然未涉及内部部署细节，但披露了关键实现决策，例如使用 "gpt-4o-mini" 进行回答、自适应并发控制，以及将评分从 [0，1] 归一化到 [0，100]。

mainPoints.point: 该框架使用 Python 3.10+，并采用显式依赖管理。
mainPoints.explanation: 要求 Python 3.10 或更高版本，并在 requirements.txt 中列出依赖项，凭据通过 CLI/环境变量处理。

mainPoints.point: 生产参数包括详细的并发与超时配置。
mainPoints.explanation: 为 Add 操作指定 64 个 worker，为 Search/Answer 指定 32 个，HTTP 超时最长 1200 秒，并具备自适应并发缩减能力。

mainPoints.point: 评分采用归一化的 [0，100] 指标，并具备稳健的错误处理。
mainPoints.explanation: 内部评分范围为 [0，1]，对外发布为 [0，100]；针对 HTTP 429/5xx 错误提供重试机制，并包含密钥轮换策略。

keyQuotes: 评分在内部按 [0， 1] 计算，对外发布为 [0， 100]。
配置的检查点值为 128 个令牌，但对外的提供商请求有意不发送 max_tokens。
